name: Jubitz Family Foundation Environment Grants (Mount Hood)
summary: General-support grants to US nonprofits restoring and protecting native forest and river ecosystems around Oregon's Mount Hood and the Columbia River Gorge. New applicants send a letter of inquiry; proposals are by invitation.

geography.label: Mount Hood and the Columbia River Gorge, Oregon

calls.label: Spring and fall grant cycles
calls.recurring: Spring cycle opens January, proposals due 31 March; fall cycle opens July, proposals due 30 September (by invitation after an LOI)

status.quote: Spring Grant Cycle Opens: January Proposals Due (Invitation Only): March 31 Funding Decision: Approximately June 30 Fall Grant Cycle Opens: July Proposals Due (Invitation Only): September 30

recurring.quote: Spring Grant Cycle Opens: January Proposals Due (Invitation Only): March 31 Funding Decision: Approximately June 30 Fall Grant Cycle Opens: July Proposals Due (Invitation Only): September 30

applicant_types.quote: The organization is a U.S. based nonprofit as defined by IRS Section 501(c)3 and can provide documentation accordingly.

geography.quote: The environment program requires that the applicant organization work in the geographic region of Oregon's Mount Hood or the Columbia River Gorge.

access.quote: Organizations new to the Jubitz Family Foundation's grant process must first submit a Letter of Inquiry (LOI).

amount.quote: OUR TYPICAL GRANT RANGE: $5000 - $25,000, one-year term
